feedback.worked_solution:
From the picture, the points $A$ and $B$ have coordinates $({x}_{1},{y}_{1})=(3,-2)$ and $({x}_{2},{y}_{2})=(1,4),$ respectively.

To find the length of $\overset{―}{AB},$ we use the distance formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}|\overset{―}{AB}| & =\sqrt{({x}_{2}-{x}_{1})^{2}+({y}_{2}-{y}_{1})^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{(1-3)^{2}+(4-(-2))^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{(-2)^{2}+{6}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{4+36} \\  & =\sqrt{40} \\  & =2\sqrt{10}\end{aligned}
$$
